bead.title: routing: escalate policy ladder instead of returning no-viable-candidate when the policy band is empty
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Unpinned routing can return `no viable routing candidate: N candidates rejected` (NoViableCandidateError, internal/routing/engine.go:369-371) when the requested policy band has zero eligible candidates at that moment — even though eligible, dispatchable candidates exist in an adjacent band (e.g. a healthy subscription harness sitting in the smart band while the request is at the default band). Observed 2026-05-28: with the local fleet down, an unpinned `ddx run` returned "16 candidates rejected" rather than selecting an available claude/codex tier.

ROOT CAUSE: the NoViableCandidateError path does not invoke the existing policy-escalation ladder. `EscalatePolicyLadder` (internal/routing/routehealth/routing_helpers.go:83-120) and `ShouldEscalateOnError` (:124) exist and implement cheap→default→smart escalation, but are not wired into the unpinned no-viable path, so a healthy candidate one band away is missed. Per spec (docs/routing/index.md:17-22, docs/routing/policies.md): unpinned routing should "select the best-scoring viable auto-routable model from the snapshot"; an empty requested band with viable candidates elsewhere should escalate, not hard-fail.

PROPOSED FIX: on NoViableCandidateError for an UNPINNED request, attempt the cheap→default→smart ladder via the existing EscalatePolicyLadder/ShouldEscalateOnError before returning the error. Hard-pinned requests must NOT escalate (they fail with candidate evidence per docs/routing/index.md:31-33).

NON-SCOPE: no change to within-band scoring; no change to hard-pin failure semantics; does not cover the separate default_provider native-path failover (tracked in fizeau-e71ba414).
bead.acceptance:
1. New test TestUnpinnedEscalatesWhenBandEmpty (internal/routing): with eligible candidates only in the smart band and an unpinned request resolved at the default policy, routing escalates and resolves to the smart-band candidate (no NoViableCandidateError).
2. New test TestHardPinDoesNotEscalate: an unsatisfiable --model/--provider/--harness pin still returns the error with attempted-route + candidate evidence (no escalation).
3. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && go test ./internal/routing/... green.
4. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
